blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation relies on persistent memory to maintain scene consistency beyond the model’s immediate temporal context. Existing systems follow two strategies to achieve this consistency. Full-history approaches retain all generated observations, causing unbounded storage and retrieval costs to grow while allowing low-fidelity memories to persist. Selective-construction approaches reduce redundancy, but make one-time retention decisions that are never revisited, even as an observation’s value changes with the evolving memory bank. Both strategies leave a shared question unresolved: as the generated history evolves, which stored observations should still remain in memory? Our key insight is that the value of a stored observation is not fixed, but relational: it depends on the alternatives currently available in the memory bank. A view supported by many geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be relinquished with little loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should remain regardless of age. We introduce Keepsake , an online, training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory. At each update, Keepsake constructs a pose–appearance graph over retained and newly generated observations, combining camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. A retention priority jointly captures the number of strong substitutes and the similarity of the closest alternative, allowing Keepsake to continually reassess memory value, preserve observations with little alternative support, and evict highly replaceable ones under a fixed budget. The controller modifies only the persistent-memory update; the host generator, denoising schedule, and retrieval rule remain unchanged. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS under a fixed memory budget; on 180-second MemCam trajectories, it retains only 32 of 5,397 frames while reducing FVD by 35.1%. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Camera-controlled video generation enables deliberate viewpoint navigation within generated scenes, supporting interactive exploration and controllable content creation. Extending this capability to long horizons requires preserving scene consistency beyond the model’s immediate temporal context, particularly when previously observed regions are revisited after substantial temporal gaps.
Recent memory-augmented methods address this challenge by maintaining historical observations associated with camera states, retrieving relevant evidence for subsequent generation, and writing newly generated observations back into persistent memory Gao et al. (2026) ; Xiao et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) . Each generation step is therefore both an output and a potential source of evidence for future generation.
blocks.zh:
相机控制的视频生成能够在生成的场景内进行审慎的视角导航,支持互动探索和可控制的内容创建. 将这种能力扩大到长的地平线,要求保持场景的一致性,超越模型的直接时间范围,特别是当以前观察到的区域在时间差距很大后再次出现时。
近期的内存强化方法通过保持与相机状态相关的历史观测,为后代取回相关证据来应对这一挑战,并将新生成的观测结果写回了持续的内存"高等"等 (2026);"萧等" (2026);"于等" (2025);"李等" (2025). 因此,每一代人的步骤既是产出,也是后代的潜在证据来源。

blocks.en: Existing spatial-memory systems commonly retain the full generation history and rely on retrieval to select relevant observations at query time Gao et al. (2026) ; Xiao et al. (2026) . This strategy introduces two coupled limitations. First, the memory archive grows continuously with generation, leading to increasing retrieval overhead as the number of stored observations expands (Fig. 1 (a)). Second, quality degradation can persist in the memory archive, allowing drifted observations to be repeatedly retrieved and reused. As shown in Fig. 1 (b), memories with well-matched viewpoints can still deviate substantially from the established scene, indicating that geometric relevance alone does not guarantee reliable memory. Fig. 1 (c) further shows the resulting inconsistency when the camera revisits the same region, where the regenerated scene no longer matches its earlier appearance.
blocks.zh: 现有空间-记忆系统通常保留了全代历史并依靠检索在查询时间高等等(2026年);萧等(2026年)选择相关观测. 这项战略提出了两个附带的限制。 首先,内存档案随着生成而持续地增长,随着存储观测数量的增加而导致回收费增加(图1(a))。 第二,质量退化可以在内存档案中持续,可以使漂移的观测被反复取回并再用. 如图一(b)所显示,具有充分相配的观点的记忆仍然可以大大地偏离既定的场景,表明光是几何相关性并不能保证可靠的记忆. 图1(c)进一步显示相机重访同一片区域时产生的不一致,再生场景不再与其早期外观相匹配.

blocks.en: Selective-construction approaches reduce redundant accumulation through spatial admission, keyframe selection, or memory merging Li et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2026) . However, these decisions are typically made only when an observation is written and are not revisited as the memory evolves. This is limiting because the value of a stored observation is inherently dynamic: a view that is unique at admission may later become redundant as similar evidence accumulates, while an older view with few substitutes may remain important. This raises a shared question across existing memory strategies: as generation proceeds, which observations should still remain in memory?
blocks.zh: 选择性构建方法通过空间吸收,键框选择,或将李等(2025年)的内存合并而减少冗余积累; 王等(2026年); 于等(2026年). 然而,这些决定通常是在一项意见被写出之后作出的,而不是随着记忆的发展而重新审视。 这一点是有限的,因为所储存的观测值本来就是动态的:一种在接纳时独一无二的观点,后来可能随着类似证据的积累而变得多余;而较老的观点,很少有替代品,可能仍然很重要. 这引起了现有记忆战略的一个共同问题:随着生成过程,哪些观察应留在记忆中?

blocks.en: We formulate this as a dynamic reassessment problem. The retention value of an observation is relational rather than intrinsic, depending on the alternatives currently available in memory. A view with several geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be removed with limited loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should be retained regardless of its age or admission-time novelty. Selective forgetting therefore serves not only to bound memory growth, but also to continually reallocate capacity toward observations that remain most informative.
blocks.zh: 我们将此视为一个动态重新评估问题。 观察的保留值是相对的,而不是内在的,这取决于目前记忆中可用的其他方法。 使用几种几何和相貌相近的替代物的观点,在有限范围丧失的情况下,可以删除,而使用极少可行的替代物的观点,无论年龄或接纳时间如何,都应当保留。 因此,有选择地忘记不仅有助于约束记忆增长,而且有助于不断重新分配观察能力,而观察资料仍然非常丰富。

blocks.en:
We introduce Keepsake , an online, training-free, plug-and-play memory controller that dynamically reassesses which observations should remain in memory. At each update, Keepsake pools the retained memory with newly generated observations and constructs a pose–appearance graph whose edge weights combine camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. Each observation is scored by its number of strong substitutes and the similarity of its closest alternative. Low-priority observations, those with many strong substitutes are evicted until a fixed budget B B is satisfied. Crucially, retention priorities depend on the current candidate set rather than being fixed at admission, so an observation that was previously important can become replaceable as new alternatives arrive.
The fixed budget bounds memory growth and retrieval overhead, while dynamic reassessment continually reallocates capacity toward observations that remain most useful.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Keepsake(Keepsake),这是一个在线的,没有训练的,插入和播放的内存控制器,它能动态地重新评估哪些观测数据应该留在内存中. 在每次更新时, Keepsake 将保留内存与新生成的观测结果汇合在一起, 并构建出一个外观图, 其边重将相机和相机的相近性与视觉相似性结合起来。 每项观测都根据其强替代物的数量及其最接近的替代物的相似性来评分. 低优先观测,那些拥有许多强替代物的人被逐出,直到固定预算B得到满足。 关键是,留用的优先次序取决于目前的候选人组合,而不是在录取时固定下来,因此,随着新的替代办法的到来,以前重要的观察可以取而代之。
固定预算限制内存增长和回收间接费用,而动态重新评估则不断将能力重新分配给仍然最有用的观测。

blocks.en: Our experiments show selective forgetting can improve generation quality while substantially reducing memory size. On fifteen matched 180-second MemCam Gao et al. (2026) trajectories, Keepsake retains only 32 observations instead of 5,397 while reducing FVD from 734.2 to 476.6, a 35.1% improvement. On fifteen matched 60-second WorldMem Xiao et al. (2026) videos, FVD decreases from 3077.6 to 1116.9. Importantly, simply imposing a memory cap is not sufficient: FIFO retention degrades generation quality relative to full retention, and different bounded policies yield substantially different results under the same budget (Tab. 1 ). These results show memory quality depends not only on how much history is retained, but also on which observations remain available.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验显示有选择的遗忘可以提高生成质量,同时会大幅降低内存大小. 15分匹配180秒的"MemCam Gao"等. (2026)轨迹,Keepsake只保留了32个观测站,而不是5,397个,同时将FVD从734.2减少到476.6,改进率为35.1%. 在15个匹配了60秒WorldMem Xiao等(2026年)的视频上,FVD从3077.6回1116.9. 重要的是,仅仅规定一个内存上限是不够的:FIFO的留存会降低生成质量与完全留存相比,不同的捆绑政策在同一预算(Tab. 1 ) 下产生大相径庭的结果。 这些结果表明,内存质量不仅取决于保留多少历史,还取决于哪些观测数据还存在。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We identify a fundamental limitation of growing spatial memory in camera-controlled long-horizon video generation and formulate retention as a dynamic reassessment problem: an observation’s value depends on the substitutes currently available in memory, rather than its age or admission-time novelty. • We propose Keepsake , a training-free memory controller that continuously reassesses retention value through pose–appearance substitutability, preserving observations with few viable alternatives under a fixed budget. • Experiments on MemCam and WorldMem show that selective forgetting can simultaneously improve long-horizon generation quality and substantially reduce memory and retrieval cost, outperforming both full-history retention and bounded baselines.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们确定在相机控制的长视距视频生成中空间内存增长的根本局限,并将保留定为动态重新评估问题:观测值取决于目前记忆中可用的替代品,而不是其年龄或录入时间的新颖性。 我们提议Keepsake是一个无培训的内存控制器,它通过姿势的可替代性不断重新评估保留价值,在固定预算下保留观测结果并没有什么可行的替代办法。 • 关于MemCam和WorldMem的实验表明,有选择地忘记可以同时提高长视距生成质量并大幅降低内存和取回成本,既能超过完整历史的保留,又能超过有限度的基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent text-to-video and image-to-video models have achieved impressive visual quality and realism Chen et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Blattmann et al. (2023) . However, they offer limited control over viewpoint evolution. Explicit camera control is therefore essential for applications that require deliberate viewpoint navigation and interactive exploration of a generated scene. Accordingly, recent studies directly condition video generation on camera trajectories Wang et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2024) ; Zheng et al. (2024) ; Hou and Chen (2024) . Yang et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) disentangle camera motion from object motion, while He et al. (2024) introduce explicit camera-pose conditioning into pretrained video generators. More recent work further improves camera controllability through geometric and correspondence priors, including epipolar constraints, trajectory-based correspondence, monocular depth, and explicit 3D scene representations Zheng et al. (2024) ; Hou and Chen (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2025) ; Li and others () ; Ren et al. (2025) . Building on camera-controllable video generation, Keepsake focuses on maintaining scene consistency over long horizons, particularly preserving previously observed content when the camera revisits earlier viewpoints after extended exploration.

blocks.en: Long-horizon camera exploration requires preserving scene information beyond the model’s local context, particularly when previously observed regions are revisited after large temporal or viewpoint gaps. Recent methods address this challenge with persistent spatial memory, storing historical observations and retrieving evidence relevant to the current viewpoint Xiao et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2026) . Other approaches organize memory through geometry-aware indexing, spatial correspondence, local spatial memories, or persistent 3D representations to better preserve cross-view consistency Li et al. (2025) ; Ren et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2026) ; Zhao et al. () ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2026) ; Hong et al. (2025) . Beyond full-history memory, long-video generation has also explored adaptive memory selection and bounded retention under limited context budgets Ji et al. (2025) ; Shi et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2026) . However, these methods either retain an expanding archive or make retention decisions primarily at admission time. Keepsake further studies how memory should be maintained as it grows, showing that retaining more historical observations is not always beneficial. It selectively preserves observations that remain useful for future revisits, improving revisit consistency while controlling storage and computation.

blocks.en:
We investigate how much spatial memory long-horizon generation needs
and how that capacity should be allocated. Our primary comparisons
use MemCam and WorldMem, varying memory retention while keeping
the generator and retrieval rule unchanged within each system.
Comparisons against complete retention test whether a compact memory
bank can preserve generation quality; comparisons at matched budgets
test whether the choice of retained observations matters.

We evaluate Keepsake in two settings: MemCam ( Gao et al., 2026 ) on the

Each primary evaluation contains fifteen matched 60-second videos.

test longer generation. Within each system, retention policies

checkpoint, generation settings, and random seeds. We report
comparisons separately for each system and duration, so that
differences between retention policies are measured under the

blocks.en: We compare Keepsake with complete retention and three bounded baselines: FIFO, K-center, and Marginal Coverage Eviction (MCE). FIFO prioritizes recency by discarding the oldest eligible observations. K-center selects representatives to improve worst-case coverage, while MCE removes observations whose deletion minimally reduces coverage over representative historical queries. Both coverage-based baselines use geometry and appearance, whereas Keepsake ranks observations by redundancy within the current candidate bank using node degree and maximum similarity. All bounded methods use the same archive budget, with B = 32 B=32 in the main comparison. Additional algorithmic details are provided in the appendix B.1 .

blocks.en: 4.4 Retention and Retrieval Diagnostics

blocks.en: Figure 3(b) shows that better viewpoint alignment does not necessarily imply more reliable historical evidence. Selected memories can match the query geometry while exhibiting greater visual drift, indicating that view relevance and memory fidelity are distinct. This distinction is important in long-horizon generation, because a geometrically suitable memory may still propagate degraded scene content. These results motivate evaluating not only which observations are stored, but also the fidelity of the evidence eventually retrieved from them.
blocks.zh: 图3(b)显示,更好的观点一致并不一定意味着更可靠的历史证据。 所选择的记忆可以匹配查询几何,同时表现出更大的视觉漂移,表明观点的相关性和记忆的忠诚性是截然不同的. 这种区分在长视距生成中很重要,因为几何相宜的记忆可能仍然会传播退化的场景内容. 这些结果不仅促使人们评估哪些观察被存储,而且促使人们评估最终从这些观察中获取的证据的可靠性。

blocks.en: We further decompose memory failure into two retrospective diagnostics: retention gap , measuring useful evidence lost through eviction, and selection gap , measuring the retriever’s shortfall relative to the best evidence still retained. Figure 3(c) shows full retention removes eviction loss but still exhibits the largest selection gap. In contrast, bounded policies trade a small amount of retention loss for a substantially smaller selection gap. This suggests that a compact archive can make useful evidence easier to retrieve, rather than simply reducing storage.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将记忆衰竭分解为两个追溯性诊断:保留漏洞、衡量因驱逐而损失的有用证据和选择漏洞、衡量检索者相对于仍然保留的最佳证据的不足。 图3(c)显示,完全保留可以消除驱逐损失,但仍显示出最大的选择差距。 相形之下,限定范围的政策只造成少量的保留损失,而选择差距要小得多。 这表明一个紧凑的档案可以使有用的证据更容易检索,而不是简单地减少存储.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Keepsake , a training-free controller that maintains
fixed-capacity spatial memory by reassessing geometric and visual
substitutability as new views arrive. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS over complete retention without
changing the generator or retrieval rule. On fifteen matched
180-second MemCam trajectories, it reduces FVD by 35.1% while
retaining 32 rather than 5,397 observations. Our diagnostics
further distinguish evidence lost through eviction from retained
evidence left unselected by retrieval, highlighting archive
maintenance as a complement to retrieval. Together, these results
demonstrate that selective retention can improve generation
quality, not merely reduce storage.
